import_detectron_ops: import detectron custom ops into the Caffe2 runtime using dyndep InitOpsLibrary
create_suffix_net: create a new Caffe2 Net that includes only ops after a given prefix length
normalize_scoped_name: remove GPU name scoping from a blob name to get the unscoped base name
create_cuda_scope: create a combined GPU name scope and CUDA device scope for a given GPU id
create_cpu_scope: create a CPU device scope for running Caffe2 operations on the CPU
